coordinateSystem: original PNG integer pixel coordinates; half-pixel eye-rim centers allowed
important: Reference eye-white regions are semantic input. Per-frame tracking proposals remain expression-sensitive; unavailable/occluded frames are flagged, never filled from whole-body bounding boxes. No image or per-frame scale is changed.
